notes.title: Balancing Update
notes.notes: When playing the game in normal mode, dying in chapter 9 no longer sends you back to chapter 8. You're welcome! Hard mode remains the same, however you can now reset a hard mode save file to chapter 1 without beating the game all over again.

notes.title: Jay and Silent Bob: Mall Brawl Arcade Edition Update
notes.notes: Mall Brawl Arcade Edition is enhanced from its original 2020 release, with crisper graphics and a rearranged score. We also re-tuned the balance and tweaked a few other things. Available now!

notes.title: Mall Brawl 1.2.0
notes.notes: Balance adjustments to chapter 3 cart race segment in normal mode. Hard mode is unaffected.
